apps.name: ESP Remote Control
apps.subtitle: iPhone keyboard and trackpad over ESP32
apps.localizedDescription: Control a USB host from an iPhone through an ESP32-S3 BLE-to-USB HID bridge. Includes English and Ukrainian input, a trackpad, a full-screen keyboard, clipboard typing, and automatic reconnect.

permissions.usageDescription: Connects to the ESP32-S3 keyboard and mouse bridge.

versions.localizedDescription: Multilingual native and full-screen keyboard, clipboard input, improved trackpad, and reliable BLE reconnect.
